content.title: Brazil's Vale reopens key mine, plans to invest $12 billion in Minas Gerais
content.summary: SAO PAULO (Reuters) -Brazilian miner Vale said on Thursday it will invest 67 billion reais ($12.36 billion) in its mining operations in Minas Gerais state by 2030, as it held a ceremony to mark the reopening of a key mine in the city of Ouro Preto.  Most of the investments will be focused on solutions to expand filtering and dry stacking of iron ore tailings, Vale said in a statement, as it seeks to reduce the use of dams in its local operations to 20% from 30%.  That has been a goal of the company after the fatal collapse of two tailing dams in Minas Gerais in 2015 and 2019, which jointly killed hundreds and caused severe environmental damage.
